definition.allocation_gain: Uniform ISR minus PIVOT-KG ISR at each cohort's primary long-response budget
definition.correction_to_margin_ratio: largest pairwise differential correction divided by the corresponding deployment margin
definition.decision_critical_pair: the union of proxy and deployment top-1 candidates at the long response
definition.decision_fragile: the ratio is at least one, equivalently the proxy top-1 set excludes the deployment top-1 set
definition.deployment_margin: top deployment delta minus the best strictly lower deployment delta
definition.native_response_gap_squared: long-minus-short difference in the sealed noise-corrected squared gap, recomputed from mechanism_audit
definition.normalized_allocation_gain: allocation gain divided by the root's deployment-delta range
definition.normalized_response_gap: absolute native response gap divided by the square of the largest root-level candidate range across proxy and long/short deployment deltas
definition.post_query_separation: final sealed estimate top-two separation divided by the root response scale; this is an observable separation diagnostic, not a posterior probability
definition.query_hits_decision_pair: the sealed PIVOT query set intersects that decision-critical pair
definition.query_noise_to_proxy_margin: mean square-root observation noise R for queried candidates divided by the proxy top-two margin
